The '''Cryospac-77 Waveskimmer''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] variant designed to be used as an aquatic patrol craft. It was armed with a twin heavy [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. It could achieve an altitude of two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above water.<ref name="HS" />
